source: Derived from WILDFIT® program food guideline documents (Weeks 1-12). All seasonal status data extracted verbatim from program PDFs. Original structured content for the Live WildFit app. Reference: WILDFIT® by Eric Edmeades — www.getwildfit.com.
usage_note: This file is foods-seed.json — the canonical seed file for the food_items Supabase table. Sugar reference entries (is_sugar_name: true) are loaded into the same table but filtered from food lookup UI. They serve as the hidden names of sugar reference database only.

week_key.2: Fall — fruit added, sugar vacation begins
week_key.11: Coming out of Spring — root veg returns

categories.1: User reached health/weight goal — less sweet fruit reintroduced
categories.2: Significant progress — deep Spring continues (default when NULL)
categories.3: Early stages — most restrictive Spring guidelines
